answers.text: Quote: 'Elder colour is advisory to me... trend leg is intact.' Answer: stage 2 and pivot are not my tests. Weekly first (C21): W 9>21, HH but LL, the tide permits a long. But the daily force read is the gate: elder 4.0, elder_5d [7, 10, 7, 5, 4] cannot prove not-red and is still falling (C2, C3), and H1 9<21, LH/LL, pos_in_day_range_pct 16.3 shows no reclaim. Permission is unresolved, so I stand aside (C22). Not conceded.
